$comment: User-generated content on a media property: comments and product reviews. Text-only domain.

content_kind.description: Whether the submission reads as a discussion comment or a product/content review.

contains_profanity.description: True if the text contains profanity or slurs (masked variants like f*** count).

personal_attack.description: True if the text attacks, demeans, or harasses a specific person (another user, an author, a named individual) rather than criticizing ideas or products. Null if genuinely ambiguous.

contains_pii.description: True if the text exposes someone's personal information: full name with address, phone number, email, or account numbers.

contains_links.description: True if the text contains any URL or domain name.

promotional.description: True if the text primarily promotes a product, service, channel, or website rather than contributing to the discussion.

disclosed_incentive.description: For reviews: true if the reviewer discloses receiving the product free or being paid; false if a review shows signs of being incentivized without disclosure ('received for free' patterns absent but text reads sponsored). Null if not a review or no incentive signals either way.

off_topic.description: True if the submission is unrelated to the article or product it is attached to. Null if the parent topic cannot be inferred.
